About this restaurant

  • Great for brunch
  • Fancy
  • Healthy
Indulge in an all-day dining affair at CUR8, our extensive buffet restaurant in Bangalore. Take a seat by the lively open kitchen to watch our chefs in action, or dine al fresco on the breezy outdoor terrace. Whether it’s a corporate lunch or a family dinner, CUR8 offers a selection of Indian and global dishes in an elegant buffet setting, creating the perfect culinary escape in Bangalore
